pages.title: A Different Hand
pages.text: Install a rune on a unique bow and successfully use that bow’s changed function.

pages.title: A Different Hand
pages.text: Change your bow’s function with a rune and test its new result.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Pain, Grace, Bounty and Chaos alter each bow differently; read that bow’s branch. A new etching replaces the previous rune. Grace often helps allies, so testing it as ordinary enemy damage is incorrect.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: An anvil etching replaces the rune; the selected bow defines what that rune actually does.
